stem: An Amsterdam webshop wants to keep building remarketing audiences for new EEA visitors. What must be in place?

options.text: A consent banner that passes all four consent mode v2 signals, including ad_user_data and ad_personalization
A consent banner that passes only analytics_storage and ad_storage, the two signals that consent mode v1 defined
A hostname include data filter that limits collection to the webshop's own domain
14-month event data retention, so EEA visitors stay in remarketing audiences for longer
